newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson criticizes Great Western on meeting.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson criticizes Great Western on meeting.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson and Co said Monday Great Western Financial Corp and Washington Mutual Inc should clarify for their shareholders whether questions about the pooling-of-interests accounting method in their planned merger are causing a delay in a meeting of Great Western shareholders.

According to an Ahmanson press release, an attorney representing Great Western said during a conference before the Delaware Chancery Court April 11 that the company cannot predict when a meeting a meeting will be held because the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is considering questions raised by Ahmanson about the accounting.
Ahmanson has a competing bid for Great Western which it has said is superior to that of Washington Mutual. The Ahmanson merger proposal uses purchase accounting.
